QuestInfo.name: [Nova] Snowing Mesos!
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Snowing Mesos!>#n\r\n

#bDuration#k\r\n
11/29 - 01/02/2018\r\n

#bDescription#k\r\n
#r#eIt's snowing mesos! What a prime time for your Cryojet Mount to make it count!#k#n\r\n

#e#p9001192##n brought you this mount for the winter. Perfect, because it can refill its water tank as the snow flurries down into the tank and melts!\r\n

More importantly, riding your #bCryojet Mount#k will make #rmeso pouches#k drift out of the sky like snowflakes!\r\n

Won't you come enjoy winter with your #bCryojet Mount#k provided by #e#p9001192##n?
